answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 763 Country: ZA Title: I want to ask about lobster and crab is it halal ? because it is not fish and according to ahnaf it is makrooh tehrimi even then many muslim eat this. give answer in detail. Question: I want to ask about lobster and crab is it halal ? because it is not fish and according to ahnaf it is makrooh tehrimi even then many muslim eat this. give answer in detail. Answer ID: 763 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 316/313=M) Crab is not allowed to consume; since it is not fish. While, the ruling over lobster ( Jhinga ) is differed and the difference is based on the ground whether it is a fish or not. So, if it is definitely a fish then it is allowed, otherwise not : لقولہ علیہ السلام: احلت لنا المیتتان: السمک والجراد Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
